title: The Myth of Sisyphus
author: Albert Camus
summary: Albert Camus opens with the question of whether life is worth living in a world without meaning. He develops the idea of the absurd and concludes that we must imagine Sisyphus happy.
readIf: you want a short, direct essay on absurdism and living without certainty.
skipIf: you want a narrative, or the topic of suicide would be distressing.
